# Prateek Saxena

> Operator, builder and strategist based in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Builds and scales businesses across eleven sectors of the UAE's real economy. Industrial engineer (Purdue University), INSEAD-educated, Certified Management Accountant (in progress). Currently Group General Manager of Al Zaabi Group. Writes on business, leadership, operations, finance, technology and the UAE economy.

## About
Prateek Saxena is an operator who builds and scales businesses across the UAE's real economy, applying engineering discipline, financial rigour and technology across eleven sectors. Career path: Process Engineer at John Deere and Operations Analyst at Bose Corporation (USA), then Corporate Strategy Officer at Delma Emirates Group, then Al Zaabi Group (Operations & Strategy Manager - Deputy General Manager - Group General Manager since May 2021).

## Sectors
Healthcare, Automotive, Real Estate, Building Materials, Contracting, Manufacturing, Trading, Retail, E-commerce, Food & Beverage, Education.

## Selected partnerships
Saint-Gobain, Bosch, Jaquar, Philips, DAMAC, Henkel, Birla White (Aditya Birla Group / Grasim Industries), Asian Paints Berger.

## Education
- Purdue University - B.Sc., Industrial Engineering (2005-2009)
- INSEAD - Certificate in Global Management; Executive Education incl. "Transforming Your Business with AI" (2024)
- Institute of Management Accountants - CMA (in progress)

## Articles
- I Don't Code. I Brief Agents. (In a Suit, No. 2) — https://prateeksaxena.me/journal/i-dont-code-i-brief-agents
  Essay by Prateek Saxena on agentic AI from the operator's chair: briefing AI agents to turn business intent into dashboards, tools and working software inside real company processes. Second entry in the "In a Suit" series.
- Confessions of an Accidental Vibe Coder (Vibe Coding in a Suit) — https://prateeksaxena.me/journal/vibe-coding-in-a-suit
  Essay by Prateek Saxena on "vibe coding in a suit": a business operator using AI agents and plain-language briefing, not code, to build the dashboards and tools a company needs. First entry in the "In a Suit" series.
- After the Prompt: The Operator's Harness — https://prateeksaxena.me/journal/after-the-prompt-operator-harness-ai
  Essay by Prateek Saxena on harness engineering for real businesses, the operator's lens, and the Self-Improvement Protocol (SIP) for making AI agents improve safely.
